purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Al Managil

queries.query: Al Managil Sudan cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the National Information Center’s Sudan Spatial Portal, the Judiciary’s General Land Registrations administration, and the national Aqari real-estate service. These establish national spatial/registration responsibilities, but no public Al Managil parcel viewer or anonymous parcel feature service was exposed.

queries.query: المناقل السودان السجل العقاري خريطة الأراضي المساحة رسمي
queries.result: First-party Arabic results identified the same national Sudan Spatial Portal, Judiciary land-registration administration, and Aqari service. No first-party city-specific Al Managil parcel map, public WFS/FeatureServer, safe parcel ID response, or geometry was found.

nationalCustodians: National Information Center: Sudan Spatial Portal project, advertised as providing OGC WMS/WFS services.
The Judiciary of the Republic of Sudan: General Land Registrations administration and registration procedures.
Aqari (aqari.nctr.sd): national Judiciary real-estate registration and certificate-request platform.
registryEvidence.locality: No first-party page or service specifically evidenced a local Al Managil registry, cadastre, map, or procedure.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: National custodian evidence is not treated as city-local registry evidence; registryFound therefore remains null.

parcelDiscovery.note: The official NIC page links to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd and describes WMS/WFS, but the host did not resolve during bounded GET/HEAD attempts. No parcel request, schema, native ID, or geometry could be verified.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 official NIC page. It describes the Sudan Spatial Portal and its intended OGC WMS/WFS capabilities, and links to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd; no inline service configuration was exposed.
DNS resolution failed in bounded requests (could not resolve host). This was recorded as service unavailability, not evidence of parcel absence; TLS verification was not disabled.

Official Judiciary land-registration administration page was available in Arabic. It describes general registration, surveying/sketch requirements, and the General Registrar’s oversight; it does not expose an anonymous parcel API or Al Managil-specific geometry.

Official-looking national Aqari service page was retrieved. It describes land-record review, search certificates, and subdivision services; no public parcel layer or safe anonymous ID+geometry response was exposed. No login or personal/property record was requested.
Retried via HTTP and HTTPS host variants; DNS remained unavailable. No alternate private-token, login, CAPTCHA, or certificate-bypass route was attempted.

safeFieldAllowlist: bounded query extent and response metadata
uncertainty: The exact WUP point [14.2446771030179, 32.9861128410293] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was never shifted or used to infer citywide absence.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, DNS failure, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was not treated as evidence that Al Managil lacks parcels.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate contents, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No raw source-specific attribute sets, synthetic row identity, or GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel identity and full geometry were verified.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: No anonymous public parcel vector response with qualified native identity, geometry, schema, CRS, and Al Managil relevance was obtained; independent serial review remains required.

recommendedDisposition: Hold for serial reviewer retry against the official Sudan Spatial Portal and any first-party Al Managil/Al Jazirah land-registration route that becomes reachable.
